next.reason: 1985 VIII.2.4.3 SR1: the ACCESS MODE clause's RELATIVE KEY 'Data-name-1 may be qualified.' 2023 states the relative key as its own clause, §2023:12.4.5.13.2 '<u>RELATIVE</u> KEY IS data-name-1', whose syntax rules (§2023:12.4.5.13.3) neither restate nor forbid qualification; qualification is general: §2023:8.4.2.2.2 'data-name-1 [ data-qualifier ] …', §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR1 (required for non-unique names) and §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR2 ('A name may be qualified even though it does not need qualification'). Same meaning.
